name: FHIR Router Mediator
description: OpenHIM mediator that routes a FHIR transaction Bundle by resource type: Patient -> OpenCR (identity), clinical -> SHR. Receives bundles on the /consolidated/fhir channel from the data pipeline and de-dupes entries. FHIR_ROUTER_IMAGE defaults to the GHCR package; set it to fhir-router-mediator:local to build locally.
